verdict.rationale: Yapily documents OpenAPI-based code generation for client libraries in Java, Python, Node.js and more, and states this is the same spec they use to generate server-side libraries, but there's no evidence of dedicated, maintained official SDK repos (e.g. on GitHub) with versioning/release history — only generated clients from a spec. The probe also found no live OpenAPI/swagger file at expected endpoints, weakening confidence in easy self-generation. missing for 10: published/maintained official SDK repositories (not just generator instructions), independent confirmation of SDK quality, and a working discoverable OpenAPI spec endpoint.
